name: SQL Analysis
description: Answer questions from your databases with the Database plugin: explore the schema, write safe, efficient queries, check the numbers and explain what they mean.
abilities: Explores the tables, columns and keys before writing a query
Writes one focused query at a time: filtered, aggregated and limited on the server
Checks results for duplicates from joins, missing values and time zones
Explains the answer with the numbers behind it, and shows any change before asking you to approve it
permissions: Uses the Database plugin and the connections you saved; Code Sandbox to chart a result

changes.notes: Exact owner review before any arbitrary remote SQL, including SELECT and preparation; local SQLite reads remain offline.
